profile.headline: Experienced Software Engineer | Passionate Problem Solver | Committed to Continuous Learning
profile.summary: With nearly a decade of experience in the IT industry, I am a dedicated and enthusiastic software engineer driven by a passion for problem-solving. I thrive on taking initiative and maintaining a proactive approach to learning. Throughout my career, I have gained expertise in various technologies, design patterns, agile methodologies, and system development life cycles. Notably, I have successfully developed software solutions for mental health care and financial sectors, showcasing my strong industry knowledge and aptitude for creating impactful solutions.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Collaborated as a member of the build team, ensuring the successful release of functionality to production.
Trained software engineers about engineering best practices and frameworks. (Spring, ReactJS, NodeJS, Jest, React Redux, Java, Apache Camel, Kafka).
Conducted comprehensive analysis and designed innovative solutions to enhance billing features on the Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) module.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed the re-architecture, design, and implementation of the Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) domain, driving efficiency and maximizing revenue generation.
Utilized domain-driven design and test-driven development methodologies to ensure robust and scalable software solutions, employing Java 8, 11, Spring, Apache Kafka, MariaDB, MongoDB, Apache Camel, and Apache Storm.
Spearheaded the development of new features to enhance CCBHC claims support, contributing to improved operational efficiency and compliance.
Mentored and trained software engineers on engineering best practices and cutting-edge frameworks such as Spring, ReactJS, NodeJS, Jest, React Redux, Java, Apache Camel, and Kafka, fostering a culture of continuous learning and growth.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Played an important role in the re-architecture, design, and implementation of the current 
system “Carelogic”, using the latest technologies and design patterns in the market.
Applied a domain-driven design to model our software using Spring Boot, Apache Kafka, Java 
8, Gradle, Git, Oracle DB, Maria DB, and Mongo DB depending on the domain. 
Developed a framework for a State Reporting project using Big Data technologies such as 
Apache Hive, Apache Storm, Apache Kafka, Talend Big Data, etc. 
Collaborated on the development of a multi-browser web application, ensuring cross-browser 
compatibilities and optimal user experience.
Facilitated the construction of different billing features to increase the capability to support 
different states and counties
positions.insights: Skills: MongoDB · Java · Scrum · Front-End Development · Git · JavaScript · Spring Boot · Oracle SQL Developer · Node.js

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Successfully developed and orchestrated the creation of a highly configurable platform catering to diverse features, configurations, and business rules for each state in the US. This initiative optimized operational efficiency and compliance on a regional level.
Skillfully configured transactions, product types, and integration points, precisely aligning them with geographic boundaries, ensuring a seamless experience across the country.
Played a pivotal role in integration projects, fostering collaboration with various third-party systems throughout the nation, enabling enhanced functionality and expanding the platform's capabilities.
Actively contributed as a core engineer in the seamless merger of the core financial system with the new platform, a critical accomplishment for the company.
positions.insights: Skills: MongoDB · Java · Front-End Development · Git · JavaScript · Spring Boot

positions.title: Programming Analyst
positions.description:
Responsible for the analysis, design, and development of the new ONP portal (Peruvian 
Government Institution, dedicated to giving retirement plans and benefits). 
Developed and enhanced existing functionality, refactoring the existing code and exposed 
Web Services to be consumed by the new web application portal. 
Updated the process to generate payments for retired individuals.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Boot · Oracle SQL Developer

positions.title: Programmer Analyst Assistant
positions.description:
Developed a core web framework to support different transactions (payments, withdrawals, 
voids, reimbursements, refunds, etc.). 
Responsible for giving support and fixing any issues or incidents that occur during this 
backend process. 
Developed government reports that the company sent monthly to identify suspicious 
transactions and laundering assets.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Front-End Development · JavaScript · Spring Boot · Oracle SQL Developer
